decisions.reason: A newly launched lever handle family fits the firm's core coordinated-family strategy, and no shortfall against aspiration is evident yet, so slack lets it continue.
The mitred handle family is a low-cost extension of established tooling and design know-how, and it is too early to judge it below aspiration.
The multifunctional handle supports the barrier-free and system-solution direction, which justifies carrying it while results are still uncertain.
A single lever handle in a broad certified range costs little to keep, and there is no evidence of a performance gap that would trigger search.
Its own page and a German Design Award show results above aspiration, making it a flagship to keep.
The bronze finish uses in-house finishing capabilities and supports the premium architectural positioning at low incremental cost.
